name: a © notice counts as a ℗ notice

name: a ℗ in the middle of a sentence counts
why: A notice starts the line, as on a sleeve (question 6). Without the anchor, "The sleeve says ℗ 1975 CBS Inc. on the back." is one. Must fail on the parser test.
grep: the notice parser

name: a compound line is never split
why: "© 1975 Laurel Canyon Music Ltd. / ℗ 1975 CBS Inc." holds a ℗ notice after a © one (Group Therapy's split). Must fail on the parser test.
